turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Please send your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address you used at checkout. Then I can check where your print is and look up the tracking link.
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.
I can’t look up an order by name or share tracking details without verifying it. If you have your order confirmation handy, please send the order number and the email address you used at checkout.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.
I can’t share a delivery address or confirm whether an order has shipped without verifying the order number and the email used at checkout. A name alone isn’t enough.
